description: Create, update, or delete a live DNS record on a hosted website's zone after confirmation. Get record ids from oma_read_site_dns. Changes are saved in the hosting account, so they stay in place. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

action.description: What to do; the tool description lists each action.

domain.description: Zone apex of the hosted website, e.g. example.fi.

name.description: Host relative to the zone, @ for apex.

serviceId.description: Service id of the website or service (from oma_read_services).

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA.

name: oma_manage_site_dns
title: Manage website DNS record
